summary: MILWAUKEE, August 21, 2026--LiveWire (NYSE: LVWR), a leader in the electric two-wheel industry, today announced the arrival of the first production S4 Honcho™ Trail motorcycles in the United States, marking the beginning of the company’s first mini-moto platform rollout across its U.S. dealer network.

title: LiveWire Group Regains Compliance with NYSE Continued Listing Standards
summary: MILWAUKEE, August 10, 2026--LiveWire Group, Inc. ("LiveWire" or the "Company")(NYSE: LVWR), announced that on August 3, 2026, the New York Stock Exchange ("NYSE") notified the Company that, based on the average closing share price of the Company's common stock for the 30-trading-day period ended July 31, 2026, the Company had regained compliance with the NYSE's minimum share price requirement.

title: From Sturgis to Sliding Sideways in Milwaukee: LiveWire and Gas Monkey Garage Reunite to Build a Custom S4 Honcho™ for New Flat Track Race Class
summary: MILWAUKEE, August 04, 2026--LiveWire (NYSE: LVWR), a leader in the electric two-wheel industry, today announced a new partnership with Richard Rawlings and Gas Monkey Garage to create a one-of-one custom S4 Honcho™ Trail motorcycle. The project marks the second collaboration between LiveWire and Gas Monkey Garage, following the highly successful custom S2 Alpinista build unveiled at the 2026 Mama Tried Motorcycle Show.
